versions.changelog:
- Initial release of donchian-strong-regime: a trend-breakdown short strategy gated by triple-confirmed strong-bear regimes.
- Validated on BTC/USDC:USDC 4h timeframe, showed +6.69% profit, 100% win rate, and 0% max drawdown over 162 days (6 trades, no losses).
- Enters only when all regime criteria (EMA separation, ADX, recent downside momentum) are met, ensuring the strategy stays out of rangy or sideways markets.
- Exits via local high break, RSI rebound, or a trailing stop; includes hard and trailing stop settings.
- Highly selective, designed to miss chop by firing no trades outside of clear bear trends; to be paired with bollinger-reverter-4h for full-regime coverage.
